findings.evidence: Extensive search found: (1) NO scheduled_tasks.json file in project .claude or home ~/.claude; (2) Only .claude/scheduled_tasks.lock exists (session lock, not data); (3) Actual task data stored per-session in ~/.claude/tasks/<sessionId>/ directories (48 sessions found, each with .highwatermark and .lock files); (4) CronCreate tool docs claim durable=true persists to scheduled_tasks.json, but this file does not exist; (5) Lock file references current sessionId, confirming task scope is session-level.

recommendation: CronCreate durable=true flag is misleading—tasks survive only within current session. For true persistence across restarts, tasks must be stored in permanent location outside .claude/tasks/<sessionId>/ or explicitly exported to git-tracked config file.
